root_cause: The 'Download OpenVINO artifacts (wheels)' step (download-artifact action) repeatedly timed out calling the GitHub Actions ArtifactService ListArtifacts twirp RPC, exhausting all 5 retry attempts over roughly 50 seconds with exponential backoff. This is a transient GitHub Actions backend/infrastructure availability issue unrelated to the PR's content: the PR under test only adds a new GPU debug transformation (force_fp32_selective) and does not touch artifact upload/download tooling or workflow configuration.
reproduction_steps: N/A - not reproducible locally; this is a transient GitHub Actions ArtifactService backend availability issue tied to the specific runner and timing of this run.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'PyTorch Models tests' job (and the dependent overall-status job) - a retry is expected to succeed since the PR's diff (GPU-only transformation pass) is unrelated to artifact handling.
If ArtifactService ListArtifacts timeouts recur across multiple PRs within a short window, check the GitHub Status page for Actions service incidents and consider escalating to GitHub Support.
prevention_strategies: No code-side prevention is possible for transient GitHub Actions infrastructure outages. The matching rerun pattern (signature_hash 8330ab6cc84bf2e1) already has a verified rerun_search_string; continuing to propose/approve it for the workflow rerunner reduces merge-queue friction from this exact signature.
